one_check_reframed.why_not_a_weakening: the old form was right while the opener was writable and a created -wal WAS the gap. A CORRECT read-only opener cannot satisfy it on a WAL store: SQLite needs -shm/-wal to READ one and mode=ro can neither checkpoint nor remove them. The database-bytes check is unchanged beside it, and a case asserts sidecars alone do not fail a run while anything else does.
